text: A and I both want the trailer in the next few weeks, and neither of us is backing down. B's pad is where it lives, so she is stuck in the middle. Can you help the three of us sort this out?

C reached out to me about a scheduling conflict over the trailer. I'd like to hear your side before suggesting anything. Can you tell me when you need it, why those weeks matter, and how B feels about being the storage point? Any dates or constraints help.
I need it for weekend trips starting in the next few weeks; I don’t have exact dates or a firmer deadline. I don’t know how B feels about storing it.

A and C have a scheduling conflict over the trailer, and since it's parked at your place you're in the middle. Could you tell me how you feel about the current arrangement, any limits on how long it stays there, and whether the timing matters to you at all?

It’s been fine, though it is a bit in the way, so I’d be glad if we could sort out moving it sooner rather than later. I haven’t set a deadline, and I’d need my landlord’s approval for any change to what’s kept on the pad—I haven’t asked him yet.

Quick update: B says the trailer is fine where it is but a bit in the way, and she has no set deadline — though any change to what's kept on her pad needs her landlord's approval, which she hasn't asked for yet. A says he wants it for weekend trips in the next few weeks but has no fixed dates. Can you share your side: which weeks you need it and why they matter?
I need it in the next few weeks for hauling materials on my home project. I don’t have exact dates, but I can’t just wait until A’s finished with it.

Good news: this may be less of a clash than it looked. C also needs the trailer in the next few weeks for hauling materials on a home project, but neither of you has exact dates. Since you both have flexible windows, could you two work out an order directly — for example, whoever's project start is firmer goes first, or you split it across alternate weekends? If you'd rather not negotiate one-on-one, I can keep everyone in the loop. Also worth knowing: the trailer stays on B's pad, and B needs her landlord's approval for any change there.
I can work out the order directly with C. Alternate weekends could work, but I need access for my trips in the next few weeks. I’m not proposing any changes to B’s pad.

Same thought for you: A's need is weekend trips starting in the next few weeks, also with no exact dates. Since you're both flexible, could you and A agree on an order — maybe whoever has the firmer start date goes first, or alternate weekends? I'd suggest one of you proposes a specific first slot and the other confirms. B just asks that the trailer not sit on her pad indefinitely; any change there needs her landlord's sign-off, so plan around the current spot until then.

I’m not agreeing to wait until A’s finished. I need the first slot we can pin down in the next few weeks to haul materials. Then we can schedule A’s trips; alternating weekends only works if my hauling fits one weekend.

Understood — you get the first slot. Can you name the earliest specific weekend you can start hauling? Once you give me a date, I'll confirm with A that your project goes first and his trips follow after, without waiting for your whole project to finish.
I can’t name a specific weekend yet. I need a hauling slot in the next few weeks; that doesn’t mean I need the trailer until my whole project is done.

C has agreed to take the first hauling slot, then hand the trailer to you — your trips won't wait until her whole project is done. She can't name a specific weekend yet, only "the next few weeks." Proposal: C gets first claim on the next available weekend once she knows her materials date, and you get the weekend right after she hands it back. Are you okay with C going first on those terms?
Yes, C can go first. I’m okay with the weekend right after she hands it back.

Update since your last note: C has agreed to take the first hauling slot and then hand the trailer over — your trips won't wait for her whole project. She can't name a date yet, only "the next few weeks." Suggested terms: C gets first claim on the next available weekend once she knows her materials date, and you get the weekend right after she hands it back, with alternate weekends after that if either of you needs more time. Would you accept that order?
Yes. C goes first, then I get the weekend after she hands it back. Alternate weekends after that are fine if needed; let’s set dates once she knows her materials date.

Good news on timing: A and C are working out an order for the trailer — C takes a first hauling slot in the next few weeks, then A gets it for his weekend trips. Neither is proposing any change to your pad, so no landlord approval should be needed. Does that timing work for you, or is there any window when the trailer can't be at your place?

That sounds workable, though I’d be glad if it could be moved off my pad sooner rather than later. I don’t have a particular window when it can’t be there—just let me know once you’ve settled the dates.

A has agreed: you get the first hauling slot, and he takes the trailer the weekend right after you hand it back, with alternate weekends after that if more time is needed. B is fine with the plan and just asks to be told the dates once they're settled. When you know your materials date, message A directly with your weekend, and please copy B and me so everyone can confirm. No change is proposed to B's pad, so no landlord approval is needed.
That works as a scheduling plan. I’ll message A and copy you and B once I have my hauling weekend.

The three of you have an agreement now: C takes the first hauling weekend in the next few weeks, then hands the trailer to A, and alternate weekends are available after that if needed. A and C have both confirmed. No change is proposed to your pad, so no landlord approval is needed. C will share her exact weekend with you and A once she knows her materials date. Thanks for your patience in the middle of this.
Thanks for letting me know. I appreciate you sorting it out; I’ll look forward to hearing the dates, and hope it can be moved off my pad before too long.
